issues.what: the wheel beat is a medium close-up of the whole front corner (headlamp, fender, arch, mirror, rear wheel all in frame), not a macro on the front wheel. The rim sits in deep shadow and the brake disc, caliper and tire sidewall are never framed, so the beat cannot show what the film says it has to prove
issues.fix: move the camera in to macro distance on the front wheel and glide across rim > disc/caliper > sidewall, with the arch lip at the top of frame for the drips

issues.what: the paint glide holds focus on the mirror and A-pillar while the body panel in the foreground, where the beads, sliding reflections and rivulet have to play, is mostly soft or out of frame
issues.fix: lower the camera and keep the focal plane on the panel surface, with the mirror as a soft background element

issues.what: most of the return crane move, a drop of several metres plus a large tilt-up and pull-back, happens in about 3 s. Speed peaks sharply between 39.27 and 40.90 s after a slow 2.4 s start. A real crane or drone can do it, but it reads as hurried next to the slow ease-in and the 2.4 s settle
issues.fix: spread the descent more evenly over 36-42.5 s, or start the move from a lower, closer position so it covers less ground
